subject: POC Hands-on Workshop: prompt inventory, routing guardrails & load-test window
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@datasync.ai>, Ryan Chen <ryan@datasync.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Hands-on Workshop: prompt inventory, routing guardrails & load-test window

Hi Elena / Ryan —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We’re excited to run the hands-on prompt review workshop for the POC. Proposed objective: validate prompt coverage, test routing/structured-output alignment, and run a short load-test to validate burst behavior for your most frequent flows.

Proposed workshop format (90–120m, interactive):
- 15m: quick roadmap + scope + goals
- 45m: hands-on prompt inventory review (live runs against dev model)
- 20m: routing & structured-output guardrails (examples + tests)
- 20m: 10k-token load-test window (controlled traffic) + results Q&A

Can you confirm which of these three 90–120m windows next week works for your team (all times PT):
- Tue 23 Mar 2027, 10:30–12:00
- Wed 24 Mar 2027, 13:00–14:30
- Thu 25 Mar 2027, 09:00–10:30

Attached: prompt_inventory_v2.xlsx (starter sheet) and a short agenda draft. Also linking our guardrails playbook and an example structured-output file: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_guardrails

If any security/compliance folks should be on the call (SOC2, IP/Q), please loop them in — we’ll keep the load test non-production and limited to your dev model.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prompt_inventory_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Park <elena@datasync.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Chen <ryan@datasync.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Hands-on Workshop: prompt inventory, routing guardrails & load-test window

Priya —

Thanks — this looks great. We’d like to take the Wed 24 Mar, 13:00–14:30 PT slot. Can you add our security lead (Gina Sanchez, g.sanchez@datasync.ai) to the invite so she can watch the load-test plan? Also confirming that the load test will be run against a dev deployment and limited to 5 minutes at the start of the ramp.

Quick ask: can you include a brief structured-output example file we can run through so our engineer has a template?

Also, Ryan will share the list of top 8 prompts we want covered in the inventory.

Elena
Head of Product
DataSync.ai

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@datasync.ai>, Ryan Chen <ryan@datasync.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Hands-on Workshop: prompt inventory, routing guardrails & load-test window

Elena — thanks for confirming. Two quick updates before I send the calendar:

1) Scheduling conflict: our VP of Solutions (expected participant for the first 15m) has an exec-level conflict on Wed 24 and asked to move to Thu 25 if that works for you. If Thu 25 09:00–10:30 PT is acceptable we’ll keep the same agenda; otherwise we can keep Wed and run without the VP for the first segment.

2) Attached a short JSONL example (structured_output_examples.jsonl) with the fields we recommend for your routing layer (id, intent_tag, entities[].start/end, confidence). We’ll walk through how to use it during the guardrails section.

Load-test note: we recommend a 5 minute ramp + 5 minute plateau at ~50 rps for the initial run (non-prod/dev only). If you want a harder stress test we can schedule a separate window with engineering.

Putting proposed options:
- Keep Wed 24 13:00–14:30 PT (no VP)
- Move to Thu 25 09:00–10:30 PT (VP attends first 15m)

Which do you prefer?

Thanks — I’ll prepare the final invite with the drive links and attachments once you confirm.

Priya

From: Ryan Chen <ryan@datasync.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena@datasync.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Hands-on Workshop: prompt inventory, routing guardrails & load-test window

> Load-test note: we recommend a 5 minute ramp + 5 minute plateau at ~50 rps for the initial run (non-prod/dev only).

Thu 25 09:00–10:30 PT works for us — Gina will be there, and we prefer the VP to be present for the intro. Attaching the list of our top 8 prompts below (copied inline):

1) "Create customer summary from notes"
2) "Classify support ticket for routing"
3) "Extract invoice fields"
4) "Rewrite policy text for tone"
5) "Generate SQL from natural language"
6) "Product recommendation funnel"
7) "Detect PII in free text"
8) "Shorten legal clauses to 2 bullets"

Ryan

DataSync.ai

Subject: Internal: Load-test ops and roles (Thu workshop)

Priya / Ben — quick internal note to align before we send the final invite:
- I’ll own the load-test execution and realtime metrics (GPU utilization, p50/p95 latencies).
- Ben will run the structured-output validation harness and capture regression screenshots.
- Priya, please confirm whether you want us to keep the ramp at 50 rps or go to 100 rps if the initial plateau looks stable; I recommend sticking to 50 for the first run.

I’ll attach the small runbook to the invite.

Karthik

Redwood Inference
